card.description: Light is a dynamic, ancient‑tech environment that morphs from subtle ambient glow to hard, crystalline beams that reshape stone into obsidian glass, culminating in a network of bioluminescent circuitry embedded in the landscape. It serves as a backdrop that amplifies the mysticism of the setting, casting tactile, photorealistic illumination that feels both primordial and incomprehensibly advanced.
visual_anatomy: **Body/Form:** Solid beam of light, hard‑light cable, obsidian glass transformation, crystalline lattice

**Key Features:** Thick white hard‑light cable extending from an inverted obsidian pyramid, a glowing blue 3D wireframe sphere within a human eye, bioluminescent veins pulsing across stone, dust particles suspended around impact points
evolution: Phase 1 (ch1‑24): Ambient soft glow emanating from bioluminescent veins across temple stone, subtle rim lighting, high‑contrast photorealism
Phase 2 (ch25‑48): Introduction of hard‑light elements—obsidian inverted pyramid, solid beam striking mountain peak, obsidian glass transformation, dust cloud
Phase 3 (ch49‑72, unknown): Expansion into a crystalline lattice of nodes pulsing bioluminescent light, interwoven hard‑light beams, landscape fully integrated into obsidian‑glass architecture
card.prompt_block: A cinematic, photorealistic environment featuring a massive black obsidian inverted pyramid hovering in the sky, extending a thick solid cable of blinding white hard‑light downwards, a mountain peak struck by a solid beam of light turning rock into smooth black obsidian glass, dust particles suspended, a glowing blue 3D wireframe sphere within a human eye, bioluminescent veins pulsing across stone, all rendered in 8k resolution with high contrast, tactile textures, ancient Ethiopian and Egyptian motifs, industrial mysticism, and an overarching sense of ancient‑tech awe
